name: Featured Collection
summary: Named passive merchandising section that composes a finite target-owned Product Card list in grid, carousel, or spotlight presentation.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Thematic section named by its required visible title; conditionally composes the canonical Collection Grid or Carousel root class.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Header grouping for the required title and optional complete view-all Link.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading whose id names the section and product list.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Link rendered only from a complete label and destination pair.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Native product ul that conditionally composes Collection Grid items layout or the focusable Carousel track.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One or more native li elements that preserve target-supplied product order and conditionally compose dependency item classes.

anatomy.name: productCard
anatomy.description: Exactly one canonical Product Card composition inside each product item.

variants.name: grid
variants.description: Default native list that composes the canonical Collection Grid root, items, and item classes.

variants.name: carousel
variants.description: Focusable native horizontal product list that composes canonical Carousel track and slide geometry without autoplay, loop, dots, or an independent controller.

variants.name: spotlight
variants.description: Container-responsive native list that gives the first supplied Product Card more parent-layout space without changing product order or Product Card internals.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single intrinsic size whose density and item geometry are private responsive composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Populated passive section with a required title and at least one Product Card.

behavior.name: namedSection
behavior.description: The required visible heading names both the thematic section and native product list.

behavior.name: productComposition
behavior.description: The target supplies one or more ordered Product Cards; list and item wrappers preserve native semantics while every child retains Product Card ownership.

behavior.name: viewAllNavigation
behavior.description: A complete optional label/destination pair composes the canonical native Link; partial pairs are omitted.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: Grid and Spotlight respond to the component container; Carousel preserves native direct scrolling and logical Scroll Snap without neutral JavaScript.

behavior.name: targetDataOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own collection selection, query, sorting, item limit, commercial spotlight order, inventory, price freshness, loading, empty, error, analytics, and update announcements; the neutral component is omitted when required content is empty.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Grid, passive horizontal Carousel list, or first-record Spotlight presentation.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading that names the section and native product list.

properties.name: viewAllLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the view-all Link unless viewAllDestination is also a non-empty real destination.
properties.description: Visible label for the optional canonical collection Link; valid only as a complete pair with viewAllDestination.

properties.name: viewAllDestination
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the view-all Link unless viewAllLabel is also non-empty.
properties.description: Real target-owned collection destination for the optional canonical Link; valid only as a complete pair with viewAllLabel.

properties.name: products
properties.description: Ordered slot containing one or more canonical Product Card compositions; empty content omits the section.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible heading and associate both the section and native product list through aria-labelledby.
Use ul and li semantics without APG Grid roles, roving focus, slide group roles, or a second Arrow-key model.
Each item contains exactly one canonical Product Card and preserves its image alternatives, name, Price, actions, focus, and status semantics.
Render the optional view-all control only as a descriptive canonical native Link with a real destination.
Make the Carousel product list keyboard-focusable and natively scrollable while preserving ordinary child Tab order.
Preserve source order in every presentation and omit the section when its required title or products are empty.
Leave loading, empty, error, data refresh, inventory, pricing, result announcements, and commercial ordering with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented by native section/list anatomy and conditional Link, Collection Grid, Carousel, and Product Card class composition with no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps a selected collection, title, presentation, bounded target product count, derived view-all Link, and canonical Product Card snippet.
